newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB leaves discount rate at 1.00 pct after meeting.
newsitem.headline: SNB leaves discount rate at 1.00 pct after meeting.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank (SNB) said it left its discount rate unchanged at 1.00 percent after Thursday's regular weekly meeting of its three-man board.

"No change," an SNB spokesman said, reiterating his comments made on Monday that the SNB was continuing to keep the market liquid. The SNB has said repeatedly its policy generally aims to keep the Swiss money market liquid in order to offset a rise in the Swiss franc, especially versus the mark.

The discount rate currently matches the historic low from February 1978 to November 1979. It was last changed when it was lowered on September 26, 1996, from 1.50 percent. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
